text: Understanding poststratification through the lens of causal inference offers a rigorous foundation for making valid population-level inferences from nonprobability samples. This framework facilitates cross-disciplinary learning and enables more principled interpretation of results from convenience samples, cohort studies, and other nonprobability sampling designs. Future work could explore how poststratification methods relate to the broader literature on generalizability and transportability of results from randomized trials.
source_label: A causal inference framework for poststratification: a method for improving external validity in epidemiological studies
